_comment: Policy-as-data for the cloud-ci-tier-dependency-acyclicity gate (Phase-0 capability-first reorg; ADR-0245/0280/0562). DATA, not code: the governed crate-root globs, the tier'd service roots, the unclassified meta roots, the ADR-0280 S-rank order, the false-green floor, and the enforcement mode. The Rust kernel hardcodes no repo fact; a different repo adopts the gate by repointing this policy. crate_root_globs mirror the root Cargo.toml workspace members (FRIC-1781069288/ADR-0538 globbed membership); the canonical resolver remains libs/oya-workspace-members-kernel — this list is the gate's own scan floor. W2 (ADR-0562 §10.29): its ROOT coverage is now DERIVED — the cross-artifact-agreement registry⇄derived-policy sync check requires a glob rooted at every capability root and every crate-owning meta dir, matched on the glob's first path segment, so a crate moved into a destination root can no longer leave the tier graph silently. The same wave closed the measured drift against the root Cargo.toml workspace members (tools/*-app and governance/corpus/* were workspace members with no glob here). enforcement is born advisory-baseline; flip to blocking only when tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json reaches zero violations (post-strangler).
flip_to_blocking_trigger: Set enforcement to "blocking" when tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json carries zero violations (the reorg strangler has fixed every substrate-inversion). Until then the gate reports baselined debt advisory-only and blocks ONLY on a NEW regression vs the frozen baseline.
